svg.title: Monthly contributions — an ink mountain landscape
svg.desc: 1,834 GitHub profile contributions across 266 active days, from 2025-10-26 to 2026-10-30. Main mountain height grows with squared monthly contributions. Each date, count, and daily calendar travels with its mountain. Fainter cragged peaks use the same drawing at different depths. Brushwork trees, mist, reflections and river life are decorative. A fish jumps at a different spot every 3 seconds. The seamless scene repeats every 180 seconds. Reduced motion is supported.
